question: In how many countries, Union Cabinet approved the opening of Indian Missions in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Union Cabinet approves the Opening of 3 Indian Missions in **Estonia, Paraguay and the Dominican Republic.**
 
• The main objective of India's foreign policy is to build a conducive environment for India’s growth and development through partnerships with friendly countries. 
 
• **Opening of Indian Missions in these three countries will help to:**
 
 
• Expand diplomatic footprint.
 
• Deepen political relations.
 
• Growth of bilateral trade.
 
• Investment and economic engagements.
 
• Stronger people-to-people contacts.
 
 
 
• This decision is a forward-looking step in pursuit of our national priority of growth and development or **‘Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas’.**
 
• The Union Cabinet was chaired by** Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
